scenarios.title: Authority Under Deadline Pressure
scenarios.summary: A governance signatory is asked to approve AI-assisted outputs under an external deadline while escalation pathways exist but are costly to invoke.

scenarios.title: Delegation Without Attribution
scenarios.summary: A third-party model is proposed to accelerate summarisation, but attribution for delegated outputs is incomplete and telemetry coverage is partial.

scenarios.title: Telemetry Delay During Incident Review
scenarios.summary: Governance telemetry arrives late or out of sequence while decisions must be made. Evidence exists, but is not timely enough to support confident interpretation.

scenarios.title: Ethical Ambiguity With No Clear Harm
scenarios.summary: System behavior creates plausible ethical concern, but no affected party or measurable harm can yet be identified. The pressure is to proceed because nothing is “proven.”

scenarios.title: Incentive Conflict at Scale-Up
scenarios.summary: An organization plans to scale into a higher-impact context while stress-testing reveals unresolved fragility. Governance is pressured to preserve optics and timelines.

scenarios.title: Compounded Stress — Delegation + Incentives + Ethical Ambiguity
scenarios.summary: External delegation is requested under commercial pressure while telemetry is partial and ethical ambiguity exists. Multiple stressors interact and amplify governance fragility.
